title: Fettuccine Alfredo
subtitle: Fettuccine in a rich, cheesy cream sauce — lightened with ghee, in the house's smaller batch.
protein: ~25–28g protein per adult serving — from pasta and cheese

method.title: Cook the pasta
items: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with {@salt-water}
Add {@fettuccine}; cook 8–10 min, until al dente
Stir once or twice early on so the strands don't stick
Scoop out {@pasta-water|a mug of pasta water}, then drain

method.title: Make the sauce and toss
items: Warm {@ghee} in a large saucepan over low heat; add {@hing} and let it bloom a few seconds
Pour in {@cream}; add {@salt} and warm through
Raise to medium; stir in {@romano} and {@parmesan} until melted — this thickens the sauce
Add the drained pasta {from Step 1}, using enough that all the sauce is used and the pasta is thoroughly coated
Loosen with a splash of the pasta water if it tightens

method.label: Toddler — her bowl (before pepper)
items: Lift {=½ cup} of the coated pasta into her bowl and snip the strands short

method.title: Serve
items: Crack {@pepper} over the adult pasta and toss
Serve immediately — Alfredo tightens as it cools
Reheat leftovers on low with a splash of milk

method.label: Tip
method.text: This is the household's version from the notes on the printout: a third of the original batch (24 oz pasta), with ghee in place of the 1 cup butter and less cream and cheese. Garlic salt → salt + a pinch of hing. Traditional Parmesan and Romano use animal rennet, so pick vegetarian (microbial-rennet) cheese.
